answer: In the PoA trust graph, endorsements are weighted by reciprocity and transitive evidence, while each contribution decays exponentially with a fixed half-life. Reputation therefore requires sustained honest service, not a brief burst. A freshly spawned identity has almost no trusted incoming mass, so its EigenTrust eigenvector centrality remains near zero and cannot meet consensus thresholds. Even an ivory bridge across a tundra of isolated accounts adds little without durable, reciprocal paths.
